author: Leo Lionni

notes: The core narrative arc is: robin threatens to eat the inchworm, inchworm offers to measure body parts to survive, measures many birds (robin, flamingo, toucan, heron, pheasant, hummingbird, nightingale), then escapes into the grass when asked to measure something impossible (a song). Key vocabulary priorities are measurement concepts (measure, long, short), the birds encountered, body parts measured (tail, beak, neck), and the escape climax. 'Song' was considered but is abstract and not easily picturable; 'escape' captures the crucial plot resolution. Existing activity_images assets (bird, robin, flamingo, toucan, grass) should be reused. 'Heron', 'pheasant', 'hummingbird', and 'nightingale' were candidates but flamingo and toucan are the most visually distinctive and likely already sourced; the 11-slot limit required prioritising the most recognisable story elements.
